concerns.text: FR-005 requires the connectivity‑strength metric to preserve sign (average of signed Pearson correlations), but T017 implements a *mean absolute* correlation. The task does not satisfy the functional requirement.
FR-009 (halt execution if retained subjects < 10) is not represented by any explicit task. No guard is defined to enforce the minimum‑subject rule.

FR-011 (verify that each retained subject has valid time‑series for both Inclusion and Exclusion) is only partially addressed by T011’s event‑marker check; there is no dedicated task that excludes subjects lacking one condition after QC.
FR-014 (exclude a subject if ROI extraction fails for any required DMN ROI) is absent. T015 extracts ROI time‑series but does not define a failure‑handling or exclusion step.
FR-016 (permutation‑test module must accept an explicit random‑seed argument) is not mentioned in any task description; the seed handling is undocumented.
SC-001 (≥ 80 % subject retention after QC) has no verification task; no step computes or asserts the retention proportion.
SC-002 (stability of permutation‑test p‑values across seeds) is not addressed by any task; the pipeline never runs the test with multiple seeds nor computes the standard deviation.
SC-006 (report mean ± SD of dynamic connectivity‑strength series per subject) is missing; T018 outputs raw window‑wise series but no summary statistics are generated.
SC-007 (power analysis) appears only in the plan; no task performs or records a power analysis.
SC-008 (dynamic multiple‑comparison control) is not reflected in a dedicated task; while T018 applies FDR, there is no explicit verification or reporting step for the corrected p‑values.
No task is defined to validate the JSON‑Schema contracts (e.g., timeseries.schema.yaml, connectivity.schema.yaml, result.schema.yaml) against the generated artifacts.

The data‑model entities (Subject, TimeSeries, ConnectivityMatrix, DynamicSeries, Result) are produced by various tasks, but there is no explicit task that ensures each entity conforms to the data‑model specification or records its creation.
